subject: science
cluster: Patterns of the sky and seasons
intro: The amount of daylight, the time between sunrise and sunset, changes with the seasons. In summer there are more hours of daylight, so days feel long and it stays light later in the evening. In winter there are fewer hours of daylight, so days feel short and it gets dark earlier. Spring and fall are in between. By observing when it gets light and dark at different times of year, we can see that the amount of daylight is related to the time of year.

items.prompt: In summer it is still light outside after dinner, but in winter it is dark by dinner. What does this tell you about daylight and the seasons?

steps: The amount of daylight is the time it stays light outside.
In summer it stays light later, so there is more daylight; in winter it gets dark earlier, so there is less.
So the amount of daylight changes with the season, with more in summer and less in winter.
solution.answer: There is more daylight in summer and less in winter, so daylight is related to the time of year.

items.prompt: In which season are the days usually the longest, with the most daylight?

steps: Longer days mean more hours of daylight.
Summer has the most hours of daylight.
So summer usually has the longest days.

items.prompt: Why does it get dark earlier in the winter than in the summer?

steps: The amount of daylight changes with the season.
Winter has fewer hours of daylight than summer.
With fewer daylight hours, it gets dark earlier in winter.
solution.answer: Because winter has fewer hours of daylight than summer, so it gets dark earlier.

items.prompt: In which season are the days usually the shortest?

steps: Shorter days mean fewer hours of daylight.
Winter has the fewest hours of daylight.
So winter usually has the shortest days.

items.prompt: A student notices the sky is bright at 8 in the evening in June but dark at 8 in the evening in December. What pattern does this show?

steps: In June (summer) it is still bright in the evening, so there is more daylight.
In December (winter) it is dark at the same time, so there is less daylight.
This shows the pattern that there is more daylight in summer and less in winter.
solution.answer: It shows more daylight in summer (June) and less in winter (December), relating daylight to the season.

items.prompt: How could you observe that daylight changes with the time of year?

steps: You would check the sky at the same time, like after dinner, in different seasons.
Notice whether it is still light or already dark at that time.
Seeing it light in summer and dark in winter at the same time shows daylight changes with the season.
solution.answer: Check if it is light or dark at the same time, like after dinner, in summer and winter to see daylight change with the season.
